blocks.text: A wine day in central Chile: private tastings in exclusive winery cellars, horseback rides through the vineyards and private dinners among the barrels. Transfer from Santiago by helicopter, approximately 1 hour, or by private car. The wine-day proposal names Maipo, Colchagua and Casablanca; the exact wineries and valleys will be agreed before your trip. VIK Chile is in Millahue, in the Cachapoal Valley. The dinner arrangements and whether they are included in your quotation will be confirmed separately, as the meal summary lists only breakfast and meals specified in the programme. Overnight at VIK Chile, Master Suite. Breakfast is included in your accommodation (BB).

blocks.text:
Private charter flight, ~5.5 hours

A private charter flight carries you thousands of kilometers into the Pacific Ocean — to the most remote island on the itinerary. Upon arrival — meet and greet, a private car to the hotel, and the first excursion: an ascent up the slopes of Rano Kau volcano to the crater-rim viewpoint, overlooking a picturesque lake with distinctive vegetation, followed by the ceremonial village of Orongo, where once a year the island's clans competed for the right of one of them to become Tangata Manu — the birdman, chosen as chief for the year.

Hotel: Nayara Hangaroa, Kainga, BB.
